issue.title: install_ui live PTY test misses the 80 ms 'compiling dependencies 87/235' frame under the 100 ms frame throttle

task_type_fields.evidence:
Proposed by bob-cli-qj.5.1.6 (note #2, PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP), triaged by the bob-cli-qj.5.1 land agent.

- bob-cli-qj.5.1.6 saw it fail during `just check-scripts` on a clean base tree (2026-11-27, apollo): `StopIteration` at `next(i for i, frame in enumerate(frames) if "compiling dependencies 87/235" in frame)` (scripts/lib/install_ui/tests/test_live.py:406).
- The bob-cli-qj.5.1 land agent reran it serially 5/5 green on an unchanged tree (bob-cli master 6f12dd0d, apollo, 2026-11-27): `python3 -B -m unittest discover -s scripts/lib/install_ui/tests -t scripts/lib -k test_real_cargo_install_transcript_uses_correct_phases_and_hides_chatter`.
- Fail rate: 1 observed failure vs 5 serial passes; the failure came under parallel host load.

Likely root cause (confident): `scripts/lib/install_ui/live.py:402` draws a frame only when `now - last_frame >= 0.1` (100 ms throttle), but the test's fake cargo transcript holds the `Building [==>] 87/235: serde` state for only `delay=0.08` s before `Compiling bob-obsidian` replaces it. The deps frame is therefore only captured when a throttled frame happens to land inside an 80 ms window, which load easily misses. Fix: hold the deps line longer than the frame throttle (e.g. 0.3 s) in the fixture, or have the test assert on the final state sequence instead of a sampled frame.

issue.creation_reason: bob-cli-qj.5.1.6 recorded this install_ui live PTY test as failing on a clean base, and the land agent found it passes on rerun, so it is a timing flake that will intermittently redden just check-scripts for unrelated agents.
